plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

response.text:
Robot stop output | dual outputs state | LOW | when configured for a robot stop output and there is a robot stop | When configured for a robot stop output and there is a robot stop, the dual outputs are LOW.
Robot stop output | dual outputs state | high | no robot stop is initiated | If there is no robot stop initiated, dual outputs are high.
Pulses on robot stop output | are | tolerated but not used | | Pulses are not used but they are tolerated.
Dual outputs | change state for external Estop | yes | external Estop is connected to a configurable safety input configured as an Emergency Stop input | These dual outputs change state for any external Estop that is connected to configurable safety inputs where this input is configured as an Emergency Stop input.
Stop output | validation | performed at the external connection to external equipment | | For the Stop Output, validation is performed at the external connection to external equipment
Stop output | connected to IMMI | not connected | to prevent an unrecoverable stop | This stop output is not connected to the IMMI (Injection Moulding Machine Interface), to prevent having an unrecoverable stop.
Dual digital outputs (SF11 Moving) | state | LOW | whenever the robot is moving (motion underway) | Whenever the robot is moving (motion underway), the dual digital outputs are LOW.
Dual digital outputs (SF11 Moving) | state | HIGH | when there is no movement | Outputs are HIGH when no movement.
Dual digital outputs (SF12 Not stopping) | state | HIGH | robot is stopping (in process of stopping or in a stand-still condition) | Whenever the robot is STOPPING (in process of stopping or in a stand-still condition) the dual digital outputs are HIGH.
Dual digital outputs (SF13 Reduced Active) | state | LOW | reduced settings are active (or initiated) for safety functions | When reduced settings are active (or initiated) for safety functions, the dual digital outputs are LOW.
Dual digital outputs (SF14 Reduced Not Active) | state | LOW | reduced settings are NOT active (or not initiated) | Whenever the robot reduced settings for safety functions are NOT active (or not initiated), the digital outputs are LOW.
